target: Pinned rustfmt accepts retained tests without behavior change
guide: Run pinned cargo fmt; retain only named four files and inspect formatter output for assertion, literal, or cfg changes. No semantic edits.
pre_mortem: Formatting could unintentionally include unrelated files or alter test data
blast_radius: Four existing Rust test source files, whitespace and module order only
detection: Exact fmt RED/GREEN and independent diff review
stop_conditions: Any assertion, literal, cfg, or behavior change
